title: Write a plain-language mission submission walkthrough
description: Explain each mission-form field with a clearly fictional example. explain public visibility and what never to submit. link the moderation policy.

title: Translate the interface into Spanish
description: Translate every English key without changing placeholders. include translator review notes. register the locale only after a fluent reviewer approves it.

title: Translate the interface into French
description: Translate every English key. preserve placeholders. document a fluent reviewer and register the locale after review.

title: Review the mission board with a screen reader
description: Use NVDA or VoiceOver. record browser and versions. test filter labels, result announcements and card links. report reproducible findings without claiming certification.

title: Test the site at 200% and 400% zoom
description: Check navigation, filters and cards at both zoom levels. record viewport and browser. provide reproduction steps for any loss of content or functionality.

title: Research official food-relief volunteer channels in Detroit
description: Identify three official organization volunteer pages. cite dates and public evidence. distinguish general volunteer pages from open requests. do not add any partner or listing without consent.

title: Review mobile usability on a real Android device
description: Record device, browser and viewport. complete filtering and clear-filter flows. document touch target or scrolling problems and concrete recommendations.

title: Review mobile usability on a real iPhone
description: Record device and Safari version. test navigation, select controls and mission links. document any reproducible problems with proposed fixes.

title: Create a respectful language guide
description: Suggest person-first language and five before/after examples. avoid stereotypes and promises of aid. cite two credible public style resources.

title: Review the beginner onboarding with a first-time contributor
description: Walk through docs/first-contribution.md. record anonymized friction points with consent. propose at least two specific improvements without publishing participant details.

title: Draft an organization consent checklist
description: Include authorization, public contact channel, expiration, correction and withdrawal. ensure consent cannot imply endorsement of the whole platform. link verification policy.

title: Document a low-bandwidth usability review
description: Test with browser network throttling. record configuration and transferred bytes. confirm useful no-JavaScript fallback. propose evidence-based improvements.

title: Research right-to-left layout requirements
description: Document logical CSS property gaps and bidi isolation needs. test a clearly labeled local pseudolocale without publishing an unreviewed translation. include screenshots and next steps.

title: Design a printable volunteer onboarding handout
description: Provide accessible text and an editable source. explain three non-code paths. include the repository URL. avoid unverified partners or impact claims.

title: Audit public link wording for clarity
description: Inventory all visible website link text. check purpose without surrounding context. propose clearer wording and flag external destinations where helpful.

title: Document privacy-safe issue examples
description: Give six fictional examples contrasting safe public submissions with sensitive data to omit. explain redaction requests and Git history persistence.

title: Add tests for accented search terms
description: Add accented and non-Latin fixtures and a documented matching policy. preserve existing filters. use synthetic data only. run npm test.

title: Design a mission detail page prototype
description: Include evidence, scope, expiry and next action. provide an accessible wireframe with keyboard order. label all example content as fictional.

title: Research volunteer safeguarding guidance
description: Cite at least three official guidance sources with check dates. cover minors, in-person safety and local variation. recommend review questions without giving legal advice.

title: Document translation review and attribution
description: Explain translator and fluent-reviewer roles, glossary conflicts, consent for public credit, stale strings and locale release requirements.

title: Add a safe broken-link report template
description: Collect public URL, expected destination and observed failure only. warn against personal information. validate form YAML and use existing labels.

title: Review dependency update and license procedures
description: Run npm audit and inspect direct dependency licenses. document review of transitive changes and immutable Action pins. report vulnerabilities privately.

title: Research rural and offline volunteering barriers
description: Cite three public sources. identify practical low-connectivity contribution paths. avoid collecting beneficiary stories or personal information.

title: Test the complete keyboard-only contribution journey
description: Navigate from skip link through filters to a mission and contribution guide. check focus visibility and order. record browser and reproducible findings.
